verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly publish versioned APIs for integrators, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack mentions no API, versioning scheme, or deprecation policy. It covers only notification enrolment, service navigation, registration/login, and service-outage notices, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
